title: ID0399600-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170001955]-Blackscreen
description:

Screen is complete black and not working. We tried connecting a PC to the screen, also not working. Checked all cables (usb, display,...) but all seems to be fine. We noticed that the screen is making a loud buzzing sound, seems something is wrong with the PCB of the screen
